result.summary: Found 1 issue: overlapping text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar delivery info line, indicating a layout/content rendering bug.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the delivery time/fee text appears garbled and overlapping ('25-3€0 delivery'), suggesting two text strings (delivery time and delivery fee) are rendering on top of each other instead of being properly spaced.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery time and delivery fee/price text elements have proper spacing or separators (e.g., a dot or margin) so they don't overlap, and verify the text container width accommodates both strings.
